connection.description: GitConnections id of the Azure DevOps connection used to authenticate this call.

project.description: Azure DevOps project the repository belongs to.

repoId.description: Azure DevOps repository id (or name) to open the pull request against.

sourceBranch.description: Branch containing the change, with or without a refs/heads/ prefix.

targetBranch.description: Branch the pull request merges into, with or without a refs/heads/ prefix.
